title: Finite algebraic comparisons for constant reduction towers
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sfb-wcontractible-constant-reductions-ml, for every integer q there exists an inverse system U of types in the coefficient universe such that U is Mittag-Leffler and the hypercohomology tower of the given constant reductions has a finite-triple comparison with U.

source.place: Tag 09C5, local algebraicity, perfect inverse-limit reconstruction, and finite-triple comparison paragraph

proof.text: For each reduction choose the local algebraic marking supplied by the perfect-constant-map lemma and normalize the consecutive quotient maps using successive derived-quotient normalization. Complete the coefficient ring and apply perfect inverse-limit reconstruction to obtain a bounded finite-projective complex whose quotient cohomology tower is Mittag-Leffler by Artin-Rees. For each finite triple t ≥ m ≥ n reduce one level-t marking to m and n; tensor associativity identifies both arrows. The resulting bijections satisfy the finite-triple comparison equations, without requiring a compatible infinite family of markings.
